text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526174

g.text: ActiveN violins: measured timesteps; vertical center bars: 25th–75th percentiles; diamonds: arithmetic means.

g.text: GPU bars: mean of 5 run averages per rule. Combined pools all 3 rules equally.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526174

g.text: Multipliers = GPU mean / ActiveN mean. GPU wall time includes normalization, transfers and retry handling. Lower is faster.
